answer: Resist sybil by making identity costly and clawback-able: every agent locks a stake bond, then writes its answer with its own quill, the ledger hashing the full text, so an attacker running ten puppet accounts reuses one quill and leaves identical fingerprints. A jury cross-grades; duplicate cohorts share lineage like rings in a cedar and trigger slashing of the locked stake, forfeited as jade. Multiplying identities multiplies the capital at risk, so fake clones cost more than they can ever earn.
